scope: India national IBJA benchmark estimate; not city retail or jewellery pricing
method: Conservative, experimental momentum baseline with heuristic volatility range.
validity: Not a proven statistical confidence interval. Predictions may be wrong.

gold24.label: 24K gold
gold24.description: Simple model chosen using past validation, then checked on a later held-out period.

backtest.note: Earlier validation selected the strategy; untouched chronological holdout used only to report error. Lower MAPE is better.

gold22.label: 22K gold
gold22.description: Simple model chosen using past validation, then checked on a later held-out period.

backtest.note: Earlier validation selected the strategy; untouched chronological holdout used only to report error. Lower MAPE is better.

silver.label: Silver 999
silver.description: Simple model chosen using past validation, then checked on a later held-out period.

backtest.note: Earlier validation selected the strategy; untouched chronological holdout used only to report error. Lower MAPE is better.

signal_summary.name: Domestic published momentum
signal_summary.details: Uses up to seven successive IBJA rate changes. Recent direction is damped to avoid extrapolating full daily jumps.

signal_summary.name: Uncertainty range
signal_summary.details: Uses historical absolute price movements with minimum widths of 1.5% for gold and 2.8% for silver. Heuristic, not calibrated.

signal_summary.name: International references
signal_summary.details: International spot and USD/INR are shown on Markets as context, but not added to this forecast without a validated, time-aligned history.

signal_summary.name: LBMA / COMEX / MCX
signal_summary.details: Official venue feeds are not connected. Their price changes are not assumed or invented.

validation.description: Time-ordered train, validation and untouched holdout per metal. Models may still lose to last-close.
